schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
ProvenAcceptableRange (new model) — per attribute x parameter PAR, the two analyses of PCMP-001 §6.4 as the report prints them
RhetoricalSpan (new model) — argument-structure roles over the report prose
out_of_schema_notes: D-002 (authoring/DISCREPANCIES.md) is recorded as the document states it: ProcessStep.description and one report statement of the Introduction carry the sentence of Section 1.1 that the production bioreactor is the only step of the A-Mab drug substance process at which product quality attributes are formed. The annex neither corrects nor labels it.

ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the set-point and NOR of the parameter table; no set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0 (the report says so). ProcessParameter.PAR is, for the four response-surface parameters, the range carried into the control strategy (the intersection of the required NOR-propagated PARs, Section 7.3); for the four univariate parameters, the range studied, which Section 7.4 supports with the other parameters at their set-points; and None for osmolality, which has no PAR from a model and for which no range beyond the NOR is claimed. rationale_for_criticality carries the classification argument of Section 9, each parameter anchored on its own sentences of it; the classes of osmolality (CPP), dissolved oxygen (GPP) and basal medium concentration (KPP) are those of the parameter register, argued by the rule of PCMP-001 §7.7.

The QualityAttribute records are the seven attributes the CQA register assigns to the step. For the five modelled attributes acceptance_criteria holds the drug substance criterion and the Version 2.0 intermediate acceptance criterion; host cell protein and residual DNA carry the drug substance criterion only, because neither has an intermediate acceptance criterion at the step. acceptance_criteria (the annex layer) holds the rows of the criteria-change table, Version 1.0 superseded and Version 2.0 in force. The aggregate criterion, tightened by the cation exchange bound and widened by the low-pH viral inactivation bound, is carried by its rows of the derivation and criteria-change tables and by the report statements of Section 7.1.

proven_acceptable_ranges: the twenty rows of the PAR table, with par_at_setpoint and par_nor_propagated as its columns 'PAR, others at set-point' and 'PAR, others across NOR' print them. The attribute cell of the table is merged, so a continuation row reads alike for several attributes; each record anchors on the contiguous span from the row that names its attribute to its own row. For this step the set-point of every factor of the designs is the centre of its range studied (the report says so).

parameter_impacts_attribute and parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute: for the four response-surface parameters, one assertion per attribute on its span of the PAR table, whose 'Required by objective 3' cell states whether the selected model has a significant term in the parameter, with the rows of the effect-size table and of the coefficient table where the model carries the main effect; for osmolality, on the screening effects and the osmolality study; for the four univariate parameters, one assertion per attribute on its row of the univariate effects table, host cell protein and DNA in the clarified harvest included (attr:hcp, attr:residual_dna).

StatisticalModelFit: the selected model of each output on all runs (terms from the coefficient tables of Section 5.3.3 and Appendix C, F statistic from the analysis of variance, replicate statistics of the centre points of the response-surface design), the plan's full quadratic on the planned runs and on all runs with a block term (re-evaluation table), the model selected on the planned runs alone with its prediction of the augmentation runs (no fit statistics are printed for it), and the five screening models (terms from Appendix C; the model F-test p only for afucosylation and high mannose, the two the report prints, and the range of the lack-of-fit p-values in the adequacy statement, as the report gives it). A p-value printed as '< 0.001' has no float value: the selected models carry it in adequacy_statement, and a term with it carries significant=true.

The schema has no record type for a discrepancy from the plan. PD-003-01 to PD-003-13 are report statements anchored on their rows of the discrepancy register and on the sentences of their subsections; the studies they record carry that row as a source reference.

The report records no deviation: a process characterization study is not GMP manufacture, so the two events of execution are study events, under the numbers Version 1.0 gave them (DEV-003-01, DEV-003-02). They are Deviation records, the schema's only record type for an event of execution. no_impact_on_conclusions is false for both: the report states what each changes and does not say that either changes no conclusion; for DEV-003-01 it says the record does not show whether the probe read high in the response-surface runs.

Studies: every row of the execution-window table has a StudyDesign record. The osmolality study S-BRX-OSM is univariate (its chronology kind); the augmentation S-BRX-AUG is a response-surface study without n_runs, which the corpus test reserves for the seeded screening and response-surface designs. Host cell protein and residual DNA are listed as responses of the three designs that measured them in the clarified harvest.

ProcessCapability.claimed_process_minimum is true for acidic variants: Conclusion 5 states that the lowest Cpk of the drug substance is that of acidic variants, which the capability data of the whole train bear out.

ControlStrategyElement records are the eight elements of Section 10; elements 2 to 4 (the combined alert, the action limit for acidic variants at harvest and the trending against the initial viable cell concentration) are recommendations of the report, which PCMR-001 consolidates.
rhetorical_spans: authoring/rhetorical/PCR-003.spans.yaml, re-curated against the Version 2.0 text in the same pass as this builder. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 3 of the A-Mab drug substance process: a fed-batch culture with a working volume of 15,000 L at commercial scale, in which the cells, expanded through the seed train from the working cell bank, secrete A-Mab into the medium over a culture of 17 days at the set-point. The production bioreactor is the only step of the A-Mab drug substance process at which product quality attributes are formed; it forms the glycan, charge variant and aggregate quality attributes of A-Mab. The culture fluid passes to harvest and clarification (Step 4) at the end of the run.
input_materials: cells expanded through the seed train to the initial viable cell concentration of the run
output_materials: culture fluid at the end of the run (harvest and clarification, Step 4)

source_references.quote: This report gives the results of the Stage 1 characterization of the production bioreactor, Step 3 of the A-Mab drug substance process.
The production bioreactor is a fed-batch culture with a working volume of 15,000 L at commercial scale, and it forms the glycan, charge variant and aggregate quality attributes of A-Mab.
The cells secrete A-Mab into the medium over a culture of 17 days at the set-point, and the culture fluid passes to harvest and clarification (Step 4) at the end of the run.
The production bioreactor is the only step of the A-Mab drug substance process at which product quality attributes are formed.

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Classified CPP under SOP-4001 by the decision logic of PCMP-001 §7.7. Osmolality lowered galactosylation in the screening design and afucosylation in the osmolality study, both critical attributes. It has no PAR from a model, because it was not a factor of the response-surface design, so its PAR cannot be shown to be wide against its NOR. At its NOR high the fitted mean of acidic variants lies below their lower limit at the least favourable combination of the other parameters, although the slope of the osmolality study is not significant. The risk of operating outside its acceptable range is therefore not shown to be low.

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Classified KPP under SOP-4001 by the decision logic of PCMP-001 §7.7. The initial viable cell concentration raised acidic variants, an attribute of very low criticality, by 3.51 points across its range, in a single significant result that may be a false positive, and no effect on a critical attribute was detected. A higher initial concentration brings the culture to its peak cell density earlier and raises the titre, so it acts on process performance. The class rests on that expected effect on growth and titre, which the record does not hold (PD-003-09).

control_strategy.description: The four WC-CPPs and the CPP osmolality are held within their NORs by the bioreactor control system. Culture pH is held by base addition, culture temperature by the vessel jacket, pCO2 by the carbon dioxide fraction of the sparge gas, osmolality through the base and feed additions, and culture duration by the day of harvest. The ranges carried into the control strategy are those of Section 7.3.

source_references.quote: The four WC-CPPs and the CPP osmolality are held within their NORs by the bioreactor control system.

control_strategy.description: A combined alert in the control system, which fires when culture pH is above 6.79, pCO2 is above 101 mmHg and culture temperature is below 35.39 °C at the same time, the side of each that lowers acidic variants. A PAR is one-dimensional, so the PAR edge of one parameter holds only while the parameters that act with it stay within limits, and here those limits lie inside their NORs. Each limit is the most unfavourable value of its parameter at which the lower 95 % limit of a single run still meets the criterion of 18.0 %, with the other factors of the model at their unfavourable NOR edges. The alert covers every combination inside the NOR that fails the criterion. Osmolality is not a factor of the response-surface design, so the harvest action limit of item 3 covers it. The NOR is read as the range that the batch record controls, about ±3 standard deviations of the chance variation of each parameter (PCMP-001 §6.4).

deviations.summary: pCO2 probe read high against the offline reference during screening run 4
deviations.impact_statement: The run is analysed at its recorded setting of 153.5 mmHg instead of its design setting of 160 mmHg, a shift of 0.108 in coded units. With the run at its design setting the set of significant screening effects is the same for every attribute. With run 4 excluded the screening model keeps two residual degrees of freedom, and fewer effects reach significance for galactosylation, high mannose, acidic variants and aggregate; for afucosylation the same number, but not the same set. The run stayed in the analysis. The record names screening run 4 only and does not show whether the probe read high in the response-surface runs, which ran later on the same probe with no recalibration recorded.

design_spaces.definition: The region of culture pH, culture temperature, culture duration and pCO2 over which every modelled attribute meets its intermediate acceptance criterion, judged on the 95 % prediction interval of a single run at manufacturing scale (both ends of the interval within the criterion of every attribute), with osmolality and the univariate parameters at their set-points and not claimed beyond the ranges studied. On a grid of 14,641 points, 73.7 % of the region studied lies inside it. Its boundary is set by the lower limit of acidic variants, which excludes 26.0 % of the grid points; galactosylation excludes 0.3 % and afucosylation 0.1 %, and high mannose and aggregate none. On the mean prediction 91.7 % of the grid would lie inside. The NOR does not lie entirely inside the design space (PD-003-08). The design space rests on the scale-down model and is not confirmed at commercial scale at its edges.

source_references.quote: The design space of this step is the region of the four response-surface parameters over which every modelled attribute meets its intermediate acceptance criterion.
It is judged on the 95 % prediction interval of a single run at manufacturing scale, as PCMP-001 §6.2 requires.
A setting lies inside it when both ends of that interval lie within the criterion of every attribute.
On the grid of 14,641 points, 73.7 % of the region studied lies inside the design space.
Its boundary is set by the lower limit of acidic variants, which excludes 26.0 % of the grid points.
Galactosylation excludes 0.3 % and afucosylation 0.1 %, and high mannose and aggregate exclude none.
Two planes of the design space in culture pH and pCO2, on the 95 % prediction interval of a single run at manufacturing scale.

statements.statement_text: This is Version 2.0 of the report.

source_references.quote: This is Version 2.0 of the report.

statements.statement_text: The scale-down model was compared with manufacturing scale in three runs at the set-points against five manufacturing-scale batches.

source_references.quote: The scale-down model was compared with manufacturing scale in three runs at the set-points against five manufacturing-scale batches.

statements.statement_text: A screening design of 19 runs varied the five parameters assigned to multivariate study, and a face-centred response-surface design of 28 runs then varied four of them.

source_references.quote: A screening design of 19 runs varied the five parameters assigned to multivariate study, and a face-centred response-surface design of 28 runs then varied four of them.

statements.statement_text: Under INV-002, 16 runs were added to the response-surface design as a second block, after the results of the planned runs were known.

source_references.quote: Under INV-002, 16 runs were added to the response-surface design as a second block, after the results of the planned runs were known.

statements.statement_text: A univariate study varied the other four parameters one at a time.

source_references.quote: A univariate study varied the other four parameters one at a time.

statements.statement_text: An osmolality study, made during the Version 2.0 re-analysis, varied osmolality with the other parameters at the combination of NOR settings least favourable for acidic variants.

source_references.quote: An osmolality study, made during the Version 2.0 re-analysis, varied osmolality with the other parameters at the combination of NOR settings least favourable for acidic variants.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface model of each of the five modelled attributes was selected on all 44 runs, by the model selection that INV-002 adopted as its corrective action CA3.

source_references.quote: The response-surface model of each of the five modelled attributes was selected on all 44 runs, by the model selection that INV-002 adopted as its corrective action CA3.

statements.statement_text: The scale comes from the Box-Cox profile, and the model is the one with the lowest AICc among all hierarchical submodels of the full quadratic.

source_references.quote: The scale comes from the Box-Cox profile, and the model is the one with the lowest AICc among all hierarchical submodels of the full quadratic.

statements.statement_text: Every selected model meets the first three adequacy criteria of PCMP-001 §7.2, a significant model F-test, no significant lack of fit and predicted R² within 0.20 of R².

source_references.quote: Every selected model meets the first three adequacy criteria of PCMP-001 §7.2, a significant model F-test, no significant lack of fit and predicted R² within 0.20 of R².

statements.statement_text: For galactosylation and acidic variants the absolute residuals rise with the predicted value, so these two models do not meet the fourth criterion, on residuals and influential runs.

source_references.quote: For galactosylation and acidic variants the absolute residuals rise with the predicted value, so these two models do not meet the fourth criterion, on residuals and influential runs.
They were used with that trend sized against their criteria (PD-003-04).

statements.statement_text: With each run flagged by its Cook’s distance deleted in turn, every attribute kept its verdict over the normal operating range (NOR), and every proven acceptable range (PAR) still contained the NOR.

source_references.quote: With each run flagged by its Cook’s distance deleted in turn, every attribute kept its verdict over the normal operating range (NOR), and every proven acceptable range (PAR) still contained the NOR.

statements.statement_text: Each attribute was judged on the 95 % prediction interval of a single run, at manufacturing scale, at every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high.

source_references.quote: Each attribute was judged on the 95 % prediction interval of a single run, at manufacturing scale, at every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high.

statements.statement_text: Afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose and aggregate meet their intermediate acceptance criteria.

source_references.quote: Afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose and aggregate meet their intermediate acceptance criteria.

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants do not meet their intermediate acceptance criterion: at nine of the 81 combinations, all with pCO2 at its NOR high, the 95 % prediction interval of a single run reaches below the lower limit of 18.0 %.

source_references.quote: At nine of the 81 combinations, all with pCO2 at its NOR high, the interval reaches below the lower limit of 18.0 %.

statements.statement_text: At the least favourable combination the predicted median is 18.4 %, a margin above the limit smaller than the bias of the model at the set-point, and about 17.7 % with the initial viable cell concentration at its NOR low.

source_references.quote: At the least favourable combination the predicted median is 18.4 %, a margin above the limit smaller than the bias of the model at the set-point, and about 17.7 % with the initial viable cell concentration at its NOR low.

statements.statement_text: The NOR was not narrowed.

source_references.quote: The NOR was not narrowed.

statements.statement_text: The risk was accepted as the producer’s.

source_references.quote: The risk was accepted as the producer’s.

statements.statement_text: This report recommends a combined alert in the control system, which fires when culture pH is above 6.79, pCO2 is above 101 mmHg and culture temperature is below 35.39 °C at the same time.

source_references.quote: This report recommends a combined alert in the control system, which fires when culture pH is above 6.79, pCO2 is above 101 mmHg and culture temperature is below 35.39 °C at the same time.

statements.statement_text: It also recommends an action limit for acidic variants at harvest of 18.72 %, and the trending of acidic variants against the initial viable cell concentration in production (Section 10).

source_references.quote: It also recommends an action limit for acidic variants at harvest of 18.72 %, and the trending of acidic variants against the initial viable cell concentration in production ( Section 10 ).

statements.statement_text: All 20 PARs computed with the other parameters varying across their NORs contain the NOR, and 18 of them span the whole range studied.

source_references.quote: All 20 PARs computed with the other parameters varying across their NORs contain the NOR, and 18 of them span the whole range studied.

statements.statement_text: That every PAR contains the NOR rests on the 16 augmentation runs and on the model selection.

source_references.quote: That every PAR contains the NOR rests on the 16 augmentation runs and on the model selection.

statements.statement_text: On the 28 planned runs alone, the PARs of culture pH, culture temperature and pCO2 for acidic variants do not contain it.

source_references.quote: On the 28 planned runs alone, the PARs of culture pH, culture temperature and pCO2 for acidic variants do not contain it.

statements.statement_text: The design space covers 73.7 % of the region studied, and its boundary is set by the lower limit of acidic variants.

source_references.quote: The design space covers 73.7 % of the region studied, and its boundary is set by the lower limit of acidic variants.

statements.statement_text: Culture pH, culture temperature, pCO2 and culture duration were classified as well-controlled critical process parameters (WC-CPPs).

source_references.quote: Culture pH, culture temperature, pCO2 and culture duration were classified as well-controlled critical process parameters (WC-CPPs).

statements.statement_text: The initial viable cell concentration, basal medium concentration and nutrient feed-1 volume were classified as key process parameters (KPPs), and dissolved oxygen as a general process parameter (GPP).

source_references.quote: The initial viable cell concentration, basal medium concentration and nutrient feed-1 volume were classified as key process parameters (KPPs), and dissolved oxygen as a general process parameter (GPP).

statements.statement_text: In the integrated model of the train the capability index of acidic variants in the drug substance is a Cpk of 1.05, between the minimum of 1.00 and the target of 1.33, and every other attribute that the step sets has a Cpk above the target.

source_references.quote: In the integrated model of the train the capability index of acidic variants in the drug substance is a Cpk of 1.05, between the minimum of 1.00 and the target of 1.33, and every other attribute that the step sets has a Cpk above the target.

statements.statement_text: That model simulates manufacturing scale directly and carries no effect of the initial viable cell concentration on acidic variants (Section 8).

source_references.quote: That model simulates manufacturing scale directly and carries no effect of the initial viable cell concentration on acidic variants ( Section 8 ).

statements.statement_text: The record of the step holds two study events and 13 discrepancies from the plan (Section 13).

source_references.quote: The record of the step holds two study events and 13 discrepancies from the plan ( Section 13 ).

statements.statement_text: Seven of the discrepancies are requirements of PCP-003 that the Version 2.0 re-analysis found unmet, among them the multivariate study that the univariate effect of the initial viable cell concentration on acidic variants calls for (PD-003-11).

source_references.quote: Seven of the discrepancies are requirements of PCP-003 that the Version 2.0 re-analysis found unmet, among them the multivariate study that the univariate effect of the initial viable cell concentration on acidic variants calls for (PD-003-11).

statements.statement_text: A-Mab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody whose main mechanism of action is antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC).

source_references.quote: A-Mab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody whose main mechanism of action is antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC).

statements.statement_text: The production bioreactor is Step 3 of the drug substance process.

source_references.quote: The production bioreactor is Step 3 of the drug substance process.

statements.statement_text: The production bioreactor is the only step of the A-Mab drug substance process at which product quality attributes are formed.

source_references.quote: The production bioreactor is the only step of the A-Mab drug substance process at which product quality attributes are formed.

statements.statement_text: Cation and anion exchange separate by net charge, and core fucose, galactose and mannose carry none, so no purification step retains one neutral glycoform in preference to another (PCP-003 §4.1).

source_references.quote: Cation and anion exchange separate by net charge, and core fucose, galactose and mannose carry none, so no purification step retains one neutral glycoform in preference to another (PCP-003 §4.1).

statements.statement_text: The neutral glycoforms of the drug substance are therefore those of the harvest.

source_references.quote: The neutral glycoforms of the drug substance are therefore those of the harvest.

statements.statement_text: They are set mainly in the Golgi before secretion, and glycosidases released by lysed cells can trim them further in the culture fluid.

source_references.quote: They are set mainly in the Golgi before secretion, and glycosidases released by lysed cells can trim them further in the culture fluid.

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants form in the cell and in the culture fluid, mainly as asparagine deamidates, and aggregate forms as antibody molecules associate in the culture fluid.

source_references.quote: Acidic variants form in the cell and in the culture fluid, mainly as asparagine deamidates, and aggregate forms as antibody molecules associate in the culture fluid.

statements.statement_text: Both rise with the time the antibody spends at culture temperature.

source_references.quote: Both rise with the time the antibody spends at culture temperature.

statements.statement_text: Host cell protein and DNA enter the culture fluid when cells die and lyse, so their load at harvest rises as viability falls late in the culture.

source_references.quote: Host cell protein and DNA enter the culture fluid when cells die and lyse, so their load at harvest rises as viability falls late in the culture.

statements.statement_text: PCP-003 §2 sets the following objectives, and Section 12 states the result against each.

source_references.quote: PCP-003 §2 sets the following objectives, and Section 12 states the result against each.

statements.statement_text: Objective 1 of PCP-003 §2: To quantify the relationship between each studied parameter and each of the five modelled responses over the ranges studied, and to identify the interactions between parameters.

source_references.quote: To quantify the relationship between each studied parameter and each of the five modelled responses over the ranges studied, and to identify the interactions between parameters.

statements.statement_text: Objective 2 of PCP-003 §2: To define the multivariate region of the response-surface parameters over which every modelled attribute is predicted to meet its intermediate acceptance criterion.

source_references.quote: To define the multivariate region of the response-surface parameters over which every modelled attribute is predicted to meet its intermediate acceptance criterion.

statements.statement_text: Objective 3 of PCP-003 §2: To establish a PAR for each parameter against each attribute whose fitted model contains a significant term in that parameter, and to confirm that the NOR lies inside that range.

source_references.quote: To establish a PAR for each parameter against each attribute whose fitted model contains a significant term in that parameter, and to confirm that the NOR lies inside that range.

statements.statement_text: Objective 4 of PCP-003 §2: To provide the demonstrated effects and the operating risk from which each parameter is classified under the parameter classification procedure SOP-4001.

source_references.quote: To provide the demonstrated effects and the operating risk from which each parameter is classified under the parameter classification procedure SOP-4001.

statements.statement_text: Objective 5 of PCP-003 §2: To provide the process understanding and the capability estimate that justify the Stage 2 operating ranges and the contribution of this step to the control strategy.

source_references.quote: To provide the process understanding and the capability estimate that justify the Stage 2 operating ranges and the contribution of this step to the control strategy.

statements.statement_text: They follow the enhanced approach of ICH Q8(R2) and ICH Q11.

source_references.quote: They follow the enhanced approach of ICH Q8(R2) and ICH Q11.

statements.statement_text: ICH Q8(R2) defines the design space and the proven acceptable range, and it treats the criticality of an attribute as a continuum.

source_references.quote: ICH Q8(R2) defines the design space and the proven acceptable range, and it treats the criticality of an attribute as a continuum.

statements.statement_text: The model selection uses the Box-Cox transformation and Akaike's information criterion with the small-sample correction (AICc), and the augmentation of the response-surface design is D-optimal.

source_references.quote: The model selection uses the Box-Cox transformation and Akaike’s information criterion with the small-sample correction (AICc), and the augmentation of the response-surface design is D-optimal

source_reference.quote: Afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose and aggregate meet their intermediate acceptance criteria.
The risk was accepted as the producer’s.
Culture pH, culture temperature, pCO2 and culture duration were classified as well-controlled critical process parameters (WC-CPPs).
Osmolality was classified as a critical process parameter (CPP)
because no PAR from a model shows a wide margin between its acceptable range and its NOR
That model simulates manufacturing scale directly and carries no effect of the initial viable cell concentration on acidic variants
The pCO2 probe drift in one screening run and the feed under-delivery to one centre-point batch (DEV-003-01 and DEV-003-02) left their runs in the analysis.
They are set mainly in the Golgi before secretion, and glycosidases released by lysed cells can trim them further in the culture fluid.

Host cell protein and DNA enter the culture fluid when cells die and lyse, so their load at harvest rises as viability falls late in the culture.

The investigation found that the criteria used to judge each step in the analysis of the proven acceptable ranges were in no approved protocol and had been set after the data were seen (INV-001 finding 1).
The records gave no execution dates (finding 5).

Their sizes are not, and the fitted models of this study give them.
The fraction of antibody secreted without core fucose therefore rises when the activity of that enzyme falls, when the donor is depleted or when the glycan spends less time in the Golgi.
The donor and the manganese cofactor of the enzyme are depleted late in a fed-batch culture, so galactosylation is expected to fall as the culture ages.
Dissolved carbon dioxide forms bicarbonate and lowers the pH in the cytosol, so a higher pCO2 is expected to move each glycan in the direction opposite to a higher culture pH.
A culture pH closer to the isoelectric point raises it, because the net charge of the antibody falls and the repulsion between molecules weakens.
These routes do not respond to a parameter in the same direction, so the net direction of each parameter on acidic variants is read from the data.
The record holds no metabolite data with which to check the supply directly.
Host cell protein is first judged in the Protein A pool.
The effect of one is therefore expected to depend on the levels of the others, and only a design that varies them together can estimate that dependence.
No PAR is claimed beyond the range studied.

Acidic variants fail their criterion over the NOR with the offset at its estimate and at either end of its interval, so that verdict does not depend on the offset either.
Its cause is not known.
The offset was estimated at the set-points only, and its use across the range studied is an assumption of PCP-003 §12.
